newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT -DLR/MARK EYES GAINS, DLR/YEN MAY DECOUPLE.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -DLR/MARK EYES GAINS, DLR/YEN MAY DECOUPLE.

text.p: *Dlr/mark upside intact unless double-top forms around 1.8913, Aug 6 high. Rebound needs to recapture 1.8710, 62-pct retrace of last week's 1.8913/1.8390 pullback. Good support at 1.8550.
*Dlr/yen must take out 116.30, 38-pct retrace of 119.58/114.25 drop. Bearish below 116 with risk of divergence with dollar/mark.
*Mark/yen to retest 62.00, helping dollar/mark. Support at 61.50.
*Cable to retest Fri's low at $1.5665. Stg/mark eyes low 2.91.
